mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_org_directory (id, workspace_id, code, display_name, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{code}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_org_unit (id, workspace_id, directory_id, code, display_name, kind, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{directoryId}, #{code}, #{displayName}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_org_unit_parent (id, workspace_id, directory_id, child_unit_id, parent_unit_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{directoryId}, #{childUnitId}, #{parentUnitId}, #{validFrom}, NULL, 'ENABLED', #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ainer_org_directory WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT id, workspace_id, directory_id, code, display_name, kind, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_org_unit WHERE directory_id = #{directoryId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT id, workspace_id, directory_id, code, display_name, kind, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_org_unit WHERE directory_id = #{directoryId} ORDER BY kind, code

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT p.parent_unit_id AS unit_id, 1 AS depth FROM ainer_org_unit_parent p WHERE p.child_unit_id = #{unitId} AND p.directory_id = #{directoryId} AND p.status = 'ENABLED' UNION ALL SELECT p.parent_unit_id, a.depth + 1 FROM ainer_org_unit_parent p JOIN ancestors a ON p.child_unit_id = a.unit_id WHERE p.directory_id = #{directoryId} AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.depth < 128 ) SELECT u.id, u.workspace_id, u.directory_id, u.code, u.display_name, u.kind, u.status, u.version, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM ainer_org_unit u JOIN ancestors a ON u.id = a.unit_id ORDER BY a.depth
